## Scope and source notes

Current Day camt052 v2 and Previous Day camt053 v2 reconciliation reports are explicitly offered. Four original XML objects recovered unchanged from the linked XLSX archives. Pre-change samples pass ISO XSDs; future-change samples fail Rsn Max4Text constraints and are preserved unchanged. Originals retained outside repository because no redistribution license was established. BMO Canada legal page says copying/redistribution/reproduction/republication requires permission unless otherwise specified.

[Publisher usage terms](https://www.bmo.com/en-ca/main/personal/legal/).
